turns.canonical_text: I'm buying my first car in the United States this weekend. I need car insurance, but I don't understand all the choices. Can you explain what I should look for?
turns.surface_text: I'm buying my first car in the United States this weekend. I need car insurance, but I don't understand all the choices. Can you explain what I should look for?

turns.canonical_text: Sure. I compared several companies when I bought my car. First, check your state's requirements. Most states require liability insurance, but the rules and minimum amounts are not the same everywhere.
turns.surface_text: Sure. I compared several companies when I bought my car. First, check your state's requirements. Most states require liability insurance, but the rules and minimum amounts are not the same everywhere.

turns.canonical_text: What does liability insurance pay for? If I cause an accident and damage another person's car, does it help with their repair bill? What about repairs to my own car?
turns.surface_text: What does liability insurance pay for? If I cause an accident and damage another person's car, does it help with their repair bill? What about repairs to my own car?

turns.canonical_text: Liability coverage generally pays for injuries or damage you cause to others, up to your policy limits. It doesn't pay to repair your own car. Collision coverage can help with that.
